en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Murazam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The performer of the exclusive Umra would cut off the Talbiyya when the camel places its hooves in the Harram’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Murazim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one who performs a separate al-‘Umrah should discontinue Talbiyah (here I am, O Lord, to obey Your command) as soon as the camel sets foot in al- Haram (the sacred area).”
